title: The Teacher Who Listened
logline: My aunt raised two daughters and taught social studies in Addis Ababa, and what she loved most was to hear her students sing.

meta.audience: DRAFT, to be confirmed by the author: my aunt's two daughters and our wider family, watching on a phone.
meta.intent: DRAFT, to be confirmed by the author: they should feel proud of her and recognise the quiet kindness she gave both her daughters and her students.

lines: The images, the narrator's voice and the music
Based on a true family story.

shots.reason: Establishes where and when: Addis Ababa at dawn, before anyone else is up, so the viewer knows her day starts early.
shots.image_prompt: Extreme wide view over the rooftops of Addis Ababa at dawn, tin roofs and eucalyptus trees, the Entoto hills behind in blue haze, one small window lit with warm lamplight, thin smoke rising, pale pink and gold sky

motion.prompt: Slow push in toward the lit window, thin smoke drifting, fixed horizon.

narration.am: አዲስ አበባ ገና ሳትነቃ፣ የአክስቴ ቀን ቀድሞ ይጀምር ነበር።
narration.om: Finfinneen osoo hin dammaqin, guyyaan adaadaa koo dursee jalqaba ture.
narration.en: Before Addis Ababa was awake, my aunt's day had already begun.

shots.subtitle: Before Addis Ababa was awake, my aunt's day had already begun.

shots.reason: Introduces her first as a mother, so the classroom scenes later are understood as her second job of care, not her only one.
shots.image_prompt: Medium shot inside a modest home at early morning, the teacher gently braiding the hair of her younger daughter while the older daughter sits beside them at a small wooden table with bread and tea, warm lamplight, a window with first daylight

motion.prompt: Her hands braid slowly, the older girl lifts her cup, the camera stays fixed.

narration.am: ሁለት ሴት ልጆች ነበሯት፤ በትዕግሥትና በፍቅር አሳደገቻቸው።
narration.om: Ijoollee durbaa lama qabdi turte; obsaa fi jaalalaan isaan guddifte.
narration.en: She had two daughters, and she raised them with patience and love.

shots.subtitle: She had two daughters, and she raised them with patience and love.

shots.reason: Links home to school in one image: the three of them leave together, which is the hinge between her two roles.
shots.image_prompt: Wide shot from behind of the teacher walking hand in hand with her two daughters down a quiet Addis Ababa street in early morning light, jacaranda trees, low walls, long soft shadows, a blue and white minibus far in the distance

motion.prompt: The three walk slowly away from the camera, leaves move in a light wind, the camera follows gently.

narration.am: በየጠዋቱ ሦስቱም አብረው ይወጡ ነበር፤ ልጆቿ ለመማር፣ እሷ ደግሞ ለማስተማር።
narration.om: Ganama ganama sadanuu waliin ba'u turan; ijoolleen ishee barachuuf, isheen immoo barsiisuuf.
narration.en: Every morning the three of them left together: her girls to learn, and she to teach.

shots.subtitle: Every morning the three of them left together: her girls to learn, and she to teach.

shots.reason: First sign of how the students felt about her: they are waiting before she arrives. Shows the love instead of only stating it.
shots.image_prompt: Wide shot of a school gate in Addis Ababa in morning sun, a group of smiling schoolchildren in navy-blue sweaters running toward the teacher as she arrives, a simple school building and a flagpole behind, dust glowing in the light

motion.prompt: Children run toward her and gather round, she opens her arms slightly, the camera stays fixed.

narration.am: በትምህርት ቤቱ በር ላይ ተማሪዎቿ አስቀድመው ይጠብቋት ነበር።
narration.om: Balbala mana barumsaa irratti barattoonni ishee dursanii ishee eegu turan.
narration.en: At the school gate, her students were already waiting for her.

shots.subtitle: At the school gate, her students were already waiting for her.

shots.reason: Says what she taught. Social studies gives the film its one concrete classroom image: the map and the globe.
shots.image_prompt: Medium shot of the teacher standing at a green chalkboard in a simple classroom, pointing with a wooden pointer at a hand-drawn chalk outline of a country map with mountains and rivers, a small globe on her desk, sunlight through a side window

motion.prompt: She traces the outline with the pointer and turns her head toward the class, the camera pushes in slowly.

narration.am: የኅብረተሰብ ሳይንስ መምህርት ነበረች፤ ስለ አገራችን፣ ስለ ሕዝቦቿና ስለ ታሪኳ ታስተምር ነበር።
narration.om: Barsiistuu Saayinsii Hawaasaa turte; waa'ee biyya keenyaa, ummattoota ishee fi seenaa ishee barsiifti turte.
narration.en: She taught social studies: our country, its peoples and its history.

shots.subtitle: She taught social studies: our country, its peoples and its history.

shots.reason: The close-up that carries her character: polite and kind even when correcting a child. This is the trait the family remembers.
shots.image_prompt: Close-up of the teacher bending down beside a wooden desk next to a small schoolboy, her face gentle and patient, one hand resting near his open exercise book, the boy looking up at her with trust, soft window light

motion.prompt: She nods and smiles softly, the boy looks up, the camera stays fixed.

narration.am: ለትንሹም ልጅ ትሑት ነበረች። ሲሳሳቱ በለስላሳ ቃል ታርማቸው ነበር።
narration.om: Mucaa xiqqaadhaafillee kabaja qabdi turte. Yommuu dogoggoran jecha lallaafaan isaan sirreessiti turte.
narration.en: She was polite even to the smallest child. When they were wrong, she corrected them gently.

shots.subtitle: She was polite even to the smallest child. When they were wrong, she corrected them gently.

shots.reason: The result of that kindness, seen from her side of the room: a class that wants to answer. Short, because the line is short.
shots.image_prompt: Wide shot of a bright classroom full of smiling Ethiopian schoolchildren in navy-blue sweaters at wooden desks, many hands raised eagerly, seen from the front of the room, sunlight across the desks

motion.prompt: Hands go up one after another, the camera pans slowly across the class.

narration.om: Kanaafidha barattoonni hundi kan ishee jaallatan.
narration.en: That is why all the children loved her.

shots.subtitle: That is why all the children loved her.

shots.reason: The heart of the film and the one detail only our family would know: she loved to hear the students sing. The longest shot, with the music at its fullest.
shots.image_prompt: Medium shot of the teacher standing by her desk with her eyes closed and a peaceful smile, listening, her piece of chalk set down on the desk, while in front of her a row of schoolchildren sing with open mouths and bright faces, golden afternoon light

motion.prompt: The children sway gently as they sing, she tilts her head and smiles, the camera pushes in slowly toward her face.

narration.am: ከሁሉ በላይ ግን ተማሪዎቿ ሲዘምሩ መስማት ትወድ ነበር። የፈለጉትን መዝሙር ቢዘምሩ፣ ጠመኔዋን አስቀምጣ ታዳምጣቸው ነበር።
narration.om: Hunda caalaa garuu yommuu barattoonni ishee sirban dhaga'uu jaallatti turte. Sirba barbaadan yoo sirban, boronqii ishee keessee isaan dhaggeeffatti turte.
narration.en: But most of all, she loved to hear her students sing. Whatever song they chose, she would put down her chalk and listen.

shots.subtitle: But most of all, she loved to hear her students sing. Whatever song they chose, she would put down her chalk and listen.

shots.reason: Returns to the home from shot 2 to close the circle: after a day of other people's children she is a mother again.
shots.image_prompt: Medium shot in the evening at home, the teacher sitting at a wooden table under a warm lamp marking a stack of exercise books, her two daughters beside her doing their homework, dark blue window behind, cosy and quiet

motion.prompt: She turns a page, one daughter leans against her shoulder, the lamp light flickers faintly, the camera stays fixed.

narration.am: ማታ ደግሞ ወደ እናትነቷ ትመለስ ነበር፤ ሁለቱ ልጆቿ ከጎኗ፣ ደብተሮቹ ጠረጴዛው ላይ።
narration.om: Galgala immoo gara haadhummaa isheetti deebiti turte; ijoolleen ishee lamaan ishee bira, dabtaroonni minjaala irra.
narration.en: In the evening she was a mother again: her two girls beside her, the exercise books on the table.

shots.subtitle: In the evening she was a mother again: her two girls beside her, the exercise books on the table.

shots.reason: The meaning and the dedication. The chalk from shot 8 returns as the closing motif in an empty room, so the last image is what she left behind.
shots.image_prompt: Close view of a single piece of white chalk resting on the wooden ledge of a green chalkboard in an empty classroom at golden hour, chalk dust floating in a beam of sunlight, rows of empty wooden desks softly out of focus, an open door with bright light beyond

motion.prompt: Chalk dust drifts in the light, the camera pulls back slowly toward the open door.

narration.am: የመምህር ሥራ በክፍል ውስጥ አይቀርም፤ በእያንዳንዱ ልጅ ልብ ውስጥ ሆኖ ከበሩ ይወጣል። ይህ ለአክስቴ ነው።
narration.om: Hojiin barsiisaa daree keessatti hin hafu; garaa mucaa hundaa keessa ta'ee balbalaan ba'a. Kun adaadaa kootiif.
narration.en: A teacher's work does not stay in the classroom. It walks out of the door inside every child. This is for my aunt.

shots.subtitle: A teacher's work does not stay in the classroom. It walks out of the door inside every child. This is for my aunt.
